clue.text: Aim to keep close in

indicators.note: one piece is told to hold the other within it, so the aim word wraps the close word

parts.note: an aim or attempt is a try
a close is an end

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to stay close to the action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close in' reads as one phrase, but 'close' is wordplay and the lone word 'in' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is in, in the sense of fashionable, is trendy.

clue.text: Tory leader runs over cat? That's slaughter!

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces sit above the cat word
the lead letter of the party word is taken

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
the ounce is the snow leopard

explanation.surface: A party chief drives over a cat, a bloody business.
explanation.definitionFit: To trounce someone is to beat them heavily, informally a slaughter.

clue.text: Bridge player opening tournament

parts.note: in bridge the four players are North, South, East and West, so E
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: A card player begins a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tournament is a sporting event or contest.

clue.text: Outlaw wantonly speared cheat

indicators.note: acting without restraint, so the letters are scattered into a new order

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them

explanation.surface: A bandit recklessly stabbed a swindler.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless criminal or outlaw.

clue.text: Pair rotavated bed for fruit tree

indicators.note: soil that is rotavated is churned up, so these letters are turned over into a new order

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A gardener digs over a couple of beds to plant a fruit tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' suggests the flower bed being dug, but it is a child's cot; 'rotavated', a gardening word for churning soil, is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The apricot is a tree grown for its orange stone fruit.

clue.text: The hunter hunted for work over a long time

indicators.note: in a down clue the work word stands above the rest

parts.note: an act is a deed or work
an eon is an age, a very long time

explanation.surface: A pursuer finds themselves pursued after toiling for ages.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth this hunter saw Artemis bathing, was turned into a stag and torn apart by his own hounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical huntsman became prey to his own dogs, a hunter hunted.

clue.text: Emperor is upset about old censure

indicators.note: the reversed ruler goes around the old letter
in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: a tsar was a Russian emperor

explanation.surface: A monarch is upset by old criticism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is upset' turns TSAR into RAST; 'about' puts O inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To roast someone is to criticise them harshly.

clue.text: Star born during expedition

indicators.note: the born letter appears within the speed word

parts.note: expedition here means promptness or speed, celerity

explanation.surface: A famous person was born on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' suggests a journey, but it means speed.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity is a famous person, a star.

clue.text: Is scrap dealer to be on the verge of ruin?

definitions.meaning: a rag-and-bone man, the British collector of scrap

definitions.text: be on the verge of ruin
definitions.meaning: to sway unsteadily, close to collapse

explanation.definitionFit: The word is British slang for a scrap collector and also means to wobble near collapse.

clue.text: Shocked Attorney General takes time

parts.note: to have is to take, as in has a bath

explanation.surface: A senior lawyer is appalled at how long things take.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means filled with horror, shocked.

clue.text: A lapse in supervision

definitions.meaning: a slip or omission that was missed
the act of watching over and managing work

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a careless omission and the job of overseeing something.

clue.text: Share out gangster's fortune

parts.note: Al Capone is the crossword's favourite gangster, giving AL
your lot is your fortune or destiny

explanation.surface: A mobster divides up his ill-gotten wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: To allot is to distribute or share out portions.

clue.text: Explosive ingredient hidden by close-knit relatives

indicators.note: the answer sits concealed inside the following words, spanning their letters

explanation.surface: A family keeps a dangerous substance under wraps.
explanation.definitionFit: Saltpetre, potassium nitrate, is a component of gunpowder.

clue.text: Swear plateau can be avoided

parts.note: to aver is to declare or swear
a tableland or table is a plateau

explanation.surface: Someone vows a high plain can be bypassed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something averted is turned away, so what is avertable is avoidable.

clue.text: Penny's restrained from liking charm

indicators.note: the penny is held back from the liking word, so it is removed

parts.note: a penchant is a liking
P is the abbreviation for penny; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A woman named Penny holds back from her fondness for charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a name; it is P, removed from PENCHANT by 'restrained from'.
explanation.definitionFit: To enchant is to bewitch or captivate, as a charm does.

clue.text: Irish county team pulls out the stops

definitions.text: Irish county team pulls out the stops

parts.words: Irish county team pulls out the stops
parts.note: read as a sports side from an Irish county giving its all; really a gadget named like that side, one that draws stoppers from bottles

explanation.definitionFit: This tool is pulled into a cork and used to draw stoppers from bottles.

clue.text: Murderer rejected popular vitamin

indicators.note: thrown back, so the murderer's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: A killer turned away from a fashionable health supplement.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicotinic acid, one of the B vitamins, goes by this name.

clue.text: A salute keeps people in harmony

indicators.note: the salute word holds the people inside it

parts.note: to greet is to salute
men means people

explanation.surface: A gesture of greeting keeps everyone getting along.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in agreement is to be in harmony or accord.

clue.text: Allude to having love for a piece of jewellery

indicators.note: with 'for' this says one letter is swapped in place of another in the word

parts.note: to broach a subject is to raise or allude to it
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone hints that they love a certain jewel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having love for a' means O goes in where an A was: BROACH becomes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A brooch is an ornamental pin worn on clothing.

clue.text: Fish a politician found in cabin

indicators.note: the politician is located inside the cabin word

parts.note: a hut is a cabin
Lib is short for a Liberal politician

explanation.surface: A politician is discovered hiding out in a hut with a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The halibut is a large flatfish.

clue.text: Scottish writer clearly upset

indicators.note: knocked over and disordered, so the word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scots author is visibly distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Carlyle was a Scottish historian and essayist.

clue.text: College head aided unsettled course attendant

indicators.note: the head of the college word is its first letter
disturbed, so the word's letters are reordered

explanation.surface: The head of a college helped a troubled assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: A caddie carries a golfer's clubs round the course.

clue.text: Greek character bust one's lip

indicators.note: broken, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of these words, including the S, form the fodder

explanation.surface: A Greek gets a split lip.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Pout after covering vehicle in stomach powder

indicators.note: the fish word wraps around the vehicle word

parts.note: the bib, also called the pout or pouting, is a fish of the cod family
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone sulks after looking at the remedy for indigestion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pout' looks like a sulk, but it is a fish, the bib.
explanation.definitionFit: Bicarb, sodium bicarbonate, is a common antacid powder.

clue.text: This month every edition is placed

parts.note: inst., short for instant, means of the current month in old business letters
all means every

explanation.surface: Each issue this month is put in position.
explanation.definitionFit: Something installed has been put or placed in position.

clue.text: A passage upset god

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is turned over, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a hall is a passage or corridor

explanation.surface: A corridor deity is overturned.
explanation.definitionFit: Allah is the Arabic name for God in Islam.

clue.text: Quits endless competition with son

indicators.note: the competition word loses its final letter

parts.note: an event is a competition

explanation.surface: A player walks out of a never-ending contest with their boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being quits means being even, with nothing owed either way.

clue.text: See about, say, a funeral song

indicators.note: the see word goes around the example abbreviation

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city, a bishop's see
eg, for example, means say

explanation.surface: Look around, perhaps, for a song of mourning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb; it is a diocese, Ely.
explanation.definitionFit: An elegy is a mournful poem or lament for the dead.

clue.text: A couple in trouble in the spring

indicators.note: the couple is placed inside the trouble word

parts.note: to ail is to trouble
PR is short for pair, a couple

explanation.surface: Two people find themselves in difficulty in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: April is a month of spring in the northern hemisphere.

clue.text: Union member thriving in jail

parts.note: a bride is one party to a marriage, a union
well means healthy, thriving

explanation.surface: A married partner flourishes behind bars.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridewell was a London prison, and the name became a general term for a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridewell is an old word for a prison or house of correction.

clue.text: Accepts heated quarrels may be met within this

definitions.text: quarrels may be met within this

parts.note: to bow to something is to accept or submit
hot means heated

explanation.surface: Someone yields to angry arguments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarrels' look like arguments, but a quarrel is a crossbow bolt, met within arrow range.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowshot is the distance an arrow travels, so bolts land within it.

clue.text: Misbehave crossing the river and be unsociable

indicators.note: the misbehave word lies across, around, the river

parts.note: to sin is to misbehave
the Tay is Scotland's longest river

explanation.surface: Someone who misbehaves ends up on the far bank and keeps to themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay in is to remain at home rather than go out socially.
